snippet.title: RpVoid Hunting day
snippet.description:
From the game I'm working on https://rpvoid.com

Went hunting with Spear, Sword and Bow some leaf bugs and mimics
(mimics are the black and white bugs pretending to be humans, they hit hard)

RpVoid is a browser base game with a persistent online world, we added combat recently so was having fun with that, there is still many bugs and polish to fix but its getting more stable now. 

Here our discord server invite link https://discord.gg/a2EwYmj
